desc: The iSeries Mil-Spec Pistol Case features trigger release latches that can be retrofitted with TSA accepted key locking latches, padlock holes include stainless steel padlock protector clips, snap down over-molded cushion grip handles on three sides for comfortable lifting and carrying, molded-in hinge for added protection and ambient pressure equalization valve. The case is waterproof, dustproof, resistant to UV, solvents, corrosion, fungus and resistant to impact damage. Made in the USA.
